WITH us_company_movies AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
),
character_keyword_movies AS (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
),
candidate_movie_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ucm.movie_id
    FROM us_company_movies AS ucm
    JOIN character_keyword_movies AS ckm ON ckm.movie_id = ucm.movie_id
),
candidate_titles AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN candidate_movie_ids AS cm ON cm.movie_id = t.id
    WHERE t.episode_nr >= 50 AND t.episode_nr < 100
),
candidate_actor_names AS (
    SELECT ci.movie_id, MIN(an.name) AS cool_actor_pseudonym
    FROM cast_info AS ci
    JOIN candidate_titles AS ct ON ct.id = ci.movie_id
    JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
    JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id
    GROUP BY ci.movie_id
)
SELECT
    MIN(can.cool_actor_pseudonym) AS cool_actor_pseudonym,
    MIN(ct.title) AS series_named_after_char
FROM candidate_actor_names AS can
JOIN candidate_titles AS ct ON ct.id = can.movie_id
